resolution: SPF and DKIM records were missing for the sending domain; added them and delivery recovered. Verified fix in production.

title: Subscription renewal pending
description: Renewal payment remains pending and the subscription is not extended. Reported via chat.
resolution: Reconciled the transaction with the gateway report and updated the payment state to completed. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: Custom domain not working
description: Custom domain shows a certificate error after setup. Raised by an enterprise account.
resolution: DNS CNAME was pointing to the wrong target; corrected the record and reissued the certificate. Documented in the runbook.

title: Wrong currency displayed
description: Prices are displayed in USD instead of the store's local currency. Started after the latest release.
resolution: Updated the store currency setting and refreshed the price cache. Documented in the runbook.

title: 3-D Secure step fails
description: The 3-D Secure verification page closes or times out and the payment is marked failed. Started after the latest release.
resolution: The 3-D Secure redirect URL was misconfigured; corrected the return URL and payments went through. Verified fix in production.

title: Confirmation emails not delivered
description: Customers are not receiving order confirmation emails. Reported via email.
resolution: SPF and DKIM records were missing for the sending domain; added them and delivery recovered. Documented in the runbook.

title: Pending payment not updating
description: Payment has been in pending for over 24 hours with no status change. Affects a single customer.
resolution: Ran the reconciliation job for the affected window; pending payments were settled automatically. Verified fix in production.

title: Notification delayed by hours
description: Shipping update notifications arrive many hours late. Affects a single customer.
resolution: SMS provider had throttled the sender ID; switched to the approved sender and OTPs were delivered. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: Duplicate transactions after retry
description: A retry after a timeout created two separate transactions. Seen by multiple customers this week.
resolution: Enabled idempotency keys on payment creation so retries no longer create duplicates. Customer confirmed the issue is resolved.

title: Account locked after failed attempts
description: User account is locked and the unlock email never arrives. Occurred on mobile app.
resolution: Device clock was out of sync so codes were rejected; synced the time and the code was accepted. Monitored for 48 hours with no recurrence.

title: API response missing fields
description: The API response no longer contains the expected fields after the release. Escalated from tier 1.
resolution: Raised the rate limit for the partner's key and advised exponential backoff on retries. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: Refund not received
description: Customer cancelled the order two weeks ago and still has not received the refund. Raised by an enterprise account.
resolution: Refund had been submitted to the bank; provided the ARN so the customer could track it, funds arrived in 5-7 business days. Closed after customer confirmation.
